parts.name: Sediment filter
parts.note: Varies by maker and model. Use a shorter cycle with poor water quality or heavy use.
parts.source: Cuckoo purifier care schedule (rental retailer page): 4 months. For reference, Coway manual (CHP-7210N): Nanotrap filter 4 months (not the same filter type). No official sediment filter document found.

parts.name: Pre-carbon filter
parts.note: Can change with source water quality and usage.
parts.source: LG Electronics Korea support: replacement cycle by filter type

parts.name: UF membrane filter
parts.note: Can change with source water quality and usage.
parts.source: LG Electronics Korea support: replacement cycle by filter type

parts.name: RO membrane
parts.note: Varies by maker and model (18 to 24 months). It changes with source water and usage, so follow your product manual first.
parts.source: Coway water purifier manual (P-6320L): RO membrane filter, expected replacement 20 months

parts.name: Post-carbon filter
parts.note: Some models use 12 months.
parts.source: LG Electronics Korea support: replacement cycle by filter type

parts.name: HEPA filter
parts.note: Shorter with long daily use or polluted air. Replace it when the indicator lights up or the filter smells.
parts.source: LG Electronics Korea support (dust filter 12 months, 6 months on some models); Dyson support (12 months)

parts.name: Carbon (odor) filter
parts.note: Some models use a 6-month cycle.
parts.source: LG Electronics Korea support: air purifier filter care (odor filter 12 months, 6 months on some models)

parts.name: Pre-filter cleaning
parts.note: This is a cleaning cycle, not a replacement. Clean it more often in dusty rooms.
parts.source: LG Electronics Korea support: air purifier filter care (wash the mesh filter once a month; some models as needed)

parts.name: AC filter cleaning
parts.note: During the cooling season. Also clean it before and after summer.
parts.source: Samsung Electronics Service Korea: clean the panel and filter about every 2 weeks

parts.name: Engine oil and filter
parts.note: Varies by model and engine (Hyundai normal schedule: 10,000 to 15,000 km or 12 months; US: 8,000 mi or 12 months). Severe use (short trips, heavy traffic) needs 5,000 to 7,500 km or 6 months.
parts.source: Hyundai owner's manuals: normal maintenance schedule (DN8 2025 US/AU, SX2 2025 Korea), severe usage (DN8 2026 Korea)

parts.name: Cabin air filter
parts.note: Varies by model and region (12 to 24 months). Replace it more often on dusty roads.
parts.source: Hyundai owner's manuals: normal maintenance schedule (SX2 2025 Korea 12 months, DN8 2025 Australia 24 months)

parts.name: Engine air filter
parts.note: Varies by model and region (36 to 48 months, about 40,000 km). Inspect it often in dusty areas.
parts.source: Hyundai owner's manuals: normal maintenance schedule (DN8 2025 Australia 48 months/40,000 km, US 36 months/24,000 mi)

parts.name: Brake fluid
parts.note: Varies by model and region (Australia 30,000 km or 24 months, Korea 50,000 km, US 48 months).
parts.source: Hyundai owner's manuals: normal maintenance schedule (DN8 2025 Australia/US, SX2 2025 Korea)

parts.name: Engine coolant
parts.note: On a new car, first replace at 200,000 km or 120 months, then every 40,000 km or 24 months (Hyundai).
parts.source: Hyundai owner's manuals: normal maintenance schedule (DN8 2025 Australia/US)

parts.name: Tire rotation
parts.note: The US manual says 8,000 mi (13,000 km) or 12 months.
parts.source: Hyundai owner's manual: normal maintenance schedule (DN8 2025 Australia)

parts.name: Car battery
parts.note: Shorter in hot climates. After 3 years, have it tested every year.
parts.source: AAA: replace every three to five years as a general rule

parts.name: Wiper blades
parts.note: 6 to 12 months, depending on climate and driving. Replace them now if they streak or chatter.
parts.source: AAA: replace every 6 to 12 months

parts.name: Toothbrush
parts.note: Replace it sooner if the bristles are frayed.
parts.source: American Dental Association (ADA): every 3 to 4 months

parts.name: Electric toothbrush head
parts.note: Based on brushing twice a day. Replace it sooner when the indicator bristles fade.
parts.source: Philips Sonicare and Oral-B support: about every 3 months

parts.name: Shower filter
parts.note: For cartridge filters (about 10,000 gallons or 6 months). Small vitamin or sediment filters can be much shorter, so follow the label first.
parts.source: Aquasana: shower cartridge lasts 10,000 gallons or up to 6 months

parts.name: Humidifier wick filter
parts.note: For wicking (evaporative) filters: 30 to 60 days. Replace it more often with hard water.
parts.source: Honeywell: change the wicking filter every 30 to 60 days

parts.name: Refrigerator water filter
parts.note: Use genuine filters.
parts.source: Samsung support (every 6 months); LG Electronics Korea support (dispenser fridge filter 6 months)

parts.name: Range hood filter cleaning
parts.note: For metal mesh grease filters. Clean them more often if you fry or stir-fry a lot. Replace carbon filters; do not wash them.
parts.source: Broan-NuTone support: wash about every month; Faber: every 2 months

parts.name: Vacuum filter wash
parts.note: For cordless vacuums. Let it dry fully for at least 24 hours.
parts.source: Dyson support: wash the cordless vacuum filter once a month

parts.name: Kitchen sponge
parts.note: Replace it now if it smells or looks dirty. University of Illinois Extension advises switching sponges and dish rags for clean ones every day and washing or sanitizing them.
parts.source: News interview with a Cleveland Clinic infectious disease specialist (at least every 2 weeks). No official institution document found.

parts.name: Pillow
parts.note: By fill: memory foam 2 to 3 years, latex 2 to 4 years, down or feather 1 to 3 years, polyester 6 months to 2 years. Replace it if it stays folded when you fold it in half. Wash pillowcases weekly.
parts.source: Sleep Foundation: most experts recommend replacing pillows every 1 to 2 years

parts.name: Mattress rotation
parts.note: For foam, latex and newer innerspring mattresses. Older innerspring: 2 to 6 months. Some mattresses must not be rotated, so check the manual first.
parts.source: Sleep Foundation: mattress care

parts.name: Smoke alarm test
parts.note: Push the test button and listen for the alarm.
parts.source: U.S. Fire Administration (USFA): test the alarm monthly

parts.name: Smoke alarm battery
parts.note: For replaceable batteries (9-volt and similar). Alarms with a sealed 10-year battery need a new alarm instead.
parts.source: U.S. Fire Administration (USFA): replace the batteries at least once every year

parts.name: Smoke alarm unit
parts.note: Count 10 years from the manufacture date, not the purchase date.
parts.source: U.S. Fire Administration (USFA): replace the entire smoke alarm every 10 years

parts.name: Fire extinguisher check
parts.note: Look at the gauge (needle in the green), the safety pin and the body. Replace or service it according to the label and local rules.
parts.source: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.157: inspect portable extinguishers visually every month

parts.name: Pet fountain filter
parts.note: Replace it more often with several pets. Clean the fountain on the same cycle.
parts.source: PetSafe support: replace the filter every 2 to 4 weeks

parts.name: Drive belt inspection
parts.note: This is an inspection cycle, not a replacement. Replace the belt if it is cracked or stretched.
parts.source: Hyundai owner's manual: normal maintenance schedule (DN8 2025 Australia), inspect every 30,000 km or 24 months

parts.name: Tire replacement (age)
parts.note: Rubber ages even without wear. Count from the manufacture date (last 4 digits of the DOT code = week and year). After 5 years, have the tires inspected every year. Replace them sooner if the tread is worn to the limit.
parts.source: Coverage of the NHTSA tire aging report: some vehicle makers say 6 years, tire makers up to 10 years. Agency original not confirmed.

parts.name: Water pitcher filter
parts.note: About 40 gallons or 2 months, whichever comes first. Replace it more often with hard water or heavy use.
parts.source: Brita: replace every 40 gallons or about every 2 months

parts.name: Washer tub cleaning
parts.note: If you skipped it for 6 months or more, run it 3 times in a row. Front loaders: run Tub Clean after about 30 washes or when tCL appears.
parts.source: LG Electronics Korea support: clean the top-load washer tub once a month

parts.name: Bed sheet washing
parts.note: If you do not sleep in the bed every day, every 2 weeks can be enough. If pets sleep in the bed, wash every 3 to 4 days.
parts.source: Sleep Foundation: most people should wash sheets once a week

parts.name: Mattress replacement
parts.note: Replace it sooner if it sags, gets noisy, or you wake up stiff. Latex can last more than 8 years.
parts.source: Sleep Foundation: replace mattresses every 6 to 8 years under normal conditions

parts.name: Humidifier tank cleaning
parts.note: Empty the tank, wipe it dry and refill it every day. Rinse well after any cleaning agent.
parts.source: US EPA: clean portable humidifiers every third day, change the water daily

parts.name: Contact lens case
parts.note: Get a new case at least every 3 months. Rinse it with solution daily and store it upside down with the caps off.
parts.source: US CDC: replace your contact lens case at least every 3 months

parts.name: CO alarm test
parts.note: Replace the batteries once a year. Replace the unit as the maker says or when the end-of-life signal sounds.
parts.source: US CPSC: test alarms monthly, replace batteries annually

parts.name: Fire extinguisher replacement
parts.note: For dry chemical extinguishers in Korea, counted from the manufacture date. Rules differ by country; follow the label and local rules.
parts.source: Korea Fire Institute (KFI): dry chemical extinguishers past 10 years from manufacture must be replaced or performance-checked
